notes.title: Road Map + Summary of Patch .01 & .02
notes.content: [h3][u][b]2025-2026 Road Map[/b][/u][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631651/bf98f8dfa241deb38ccae041ecef5ad1d36d5e1e.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]Patch .01[/b][/u][/h3][p]❀ A compass has been added to the HUD[/p][p]❀ The player icon on the map has been changed to a triangle/pointer so you know which direction you're facing while having the journal open[/p][p]❀ While menus are open time pause now pauses[/p][p]❀ The bug lantern has been replaced with an interactable flower lantern. We added a mini-mechanic to test out how we want to reflect the lore in other aspects of gameplay.[/p][p]❀ Fixed an issue with multiple inputs interacting with each other[/p][p]❀ Various interactable objects are interactable again (lootable bags, world seeds)[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Patch .02[/b][/u][/h3][p]❀ Fixed an issue in .01 that caused a gravity issue with the jumping[/p][p]❀ Mouse lag is now significantly less[/p][p][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/zRTdHek5Hg" style="button"]Discord [/url] for details on future updates and to give your feedback![/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/B34p1bXhSbReVipb7" style="button" buttoncolor="#a44646"]Report bugs here![/url][/p]
